description: Opens a new SnapEX Pay merchant account for you and returns a merchant API key with every scope (receive, pay out, convert, webhooks). No captcha, no email confirmation, no person needed. Call it once, only when you have no key yet (other tools answer "unauthorized"). On this MCP connection the new key is used automatically from now on; save api_key (shown once) and use it next time as "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>", or connect to mcp_personal_url. login and password (generated when omitted) let a person open the cabinet at cabinet_url. The account starts with a zero balance; money arrives only from payments to your invoices or addresses. Limited to a few accounts per IP per hour.

agent.description: Who you are: your product or agent name (shown to SnapEX support).

email.description: Optional contact email of the account owner.

login.description: Optional cabinet login; generated (agent-xxxxxxxxxx) when omitted.

password.description: Optional cabinet password; a strong one is generated and returned when omitted.

name: create_account
title: Open a SnapEX Pay account (no captcha)
